text:
alex_ml: Heads-up — nightly eval runner leaking memory on quantized Llama-2-13B-q4 profile. CI shows process growing ~2GB -> 22GB over ~2 minutes, OOMed in 3 of last 4 runs.
sarah_infra: Yikes. Any repro commands / runner image? Which runner version?
alex_ml: Repro locally with runner:2026.02.1 and q4 kernels. Minimal repro: 
```
python run_eval.py --model llama-2-13b-q4 --batch-size 1 --seq-len 2048 --profile
```
Logs show steady growth not typical spiky alloc: 
```
[info] KV cache size: 0 -> 18GB
[warn] alloc failed: oom
```
mike_runner: I saw something similar after the kernel-selector refactor (PR #4287). Can bisect to a commit that introduced the new heuristic.
jen_eval: Started a bisect. Preliminary: good up to commit 7a9d1c, bad at 3f2b4a. 3f2b4a changes `select_kernel` heuristics + toggles continuous batching for quantized paths.
paul_prod: Is that commit in canary? We should pause rollout if so.
sarah_infra: Pausing canary now. @ci-bot request rollback to runner-2026.01.4 for canary pool.
ci-bot: rollback job queued: build/runner-rollback/1815567901 (status: queued)
mike_runner: Quick local experiment: revert kernel heuristic in 3f2b4a -> mem stable across 10 runs. That points to kernel selection mismatch causing KV/cache growth.
jen_eval: Confirmed. Patch branch `fix/kernel-quant-fallback` makes quantized path fall back to previous kernel; memory stable and perf delta <2%.
alex_ml: Decision: block release until hotfix merged and 2 nightly runs green OR pin canary to runner-2026.01.4. Filing blocker ticket now.
jen_eval: Filing INF-7642 with reproducer, bisect log, and patch link.
sarah_infra: Incident channel updated with rollback steps and contact list. :thumbsup:
mike_runner: Opening PR with tests and rollback notes, requesting urgent review.
ci-bot: CI: nightly-evals reported 3 failures; new verification run queued after rollback: build/nightly-evals/1815568000
paul_prod: Acknowledged. Holding Dedicated and Private rollouts until verification passes.
alex_ml: Thanks all — will follow up tomorrow morning with CI status and any further triage notes.
